en.title: Yingge Dance Beyond Viral Clips: Read a Real Performance
en.headline: See Formation, Rhythm and Local Style—not Just Painted Faces
en.description: Verify a real Chaoshan Yingge performance, distinguish Chaoyang, Puning and Jiazi records, and follow formation, rhythm and procession without inventing one national rule.
en.heroAlt: A named Yingge troupe performing at a documented event in eastern Guangdong, with paired sticks and formation visible.
en.featuredLinkLabel: Go beyond the viral Yingge clip
